risks.quote: Gen AI may be useful, but it can also be wrong.
Did you also know that gen AI tools can collect and share prompts and inputs for training purposes?
Gen AI tools will plagiarize directly from other sources.
Every use of gen AI has an environmental cost.
Gen AI can support learning, but it shouldn't replace the thinking, practice, and reflection that help you grow.

responsibilities.quote: You are responsible for anything you submit, even if it was created with a gen AI tool.
Not every gen AI output is accurate, reliable, and relevant. So, before using any outputs, apply the E.V.E.R.Y. framework.
All Laurier students, staff and faculty are expected to follow Laurier's principles of use for gen AI.
Complete these self-paced learning modules to help you build the knowledge and judgement you need to make responsible decisions about gen AI in your academic work.
If you use gen AI, do so thoughtfully, be transparent about its use, and work closely with your advisor to make informed decisions throughout your research journey.
